approval_authority.description: Every transaction must be approved by the correct authority level based on amount.

preferred_supplier.description: All purchases must use a preferred supplier unless an approved exception exists.

documentation.description: Every transaction must have complete documentation per the contract type.

split_order_detection.description: Flag transactions from the same supplier within 5 business days that individually fall below a threshold but combined exceed it.

breach_escalation.description: If total breach count exceeds 15 in a single compliance run, escalate to VP of Procurement.
